text.tspan: a Waiting across all confirmed sequences
b Operating costs and delivery credit
c Value assigned to waiting changes entry
Reference workload only: four calls, 16-h starts, 300 sequences/product including failures. a: empirical distributions; dotted means.
b-d: 12 independent series/year, 2,000 annual draws, 1-MW accounting, no site fee. Waiting price 0.005 in b,d.
Electricity USD 0.10/kWh; delivery credit USD 50/MWh; missed-work price zero. d: fifth-percentile net-value choice.
